text: The Nox were a race in the base Elden Ring game who foresaw an age of stars and a Lord of Night, and waited underground in eternal anticipation of it.
The Nightfarers are warriors unaligned by tribe, clan, region, or era, sharing no common station or purpose, but united by a shared will to resist the Night and defeat the Night Lord.
The Priestess states that the Nightfarers were chosen by a Formless Master for their potential to defeat the Night Lord.
Nightfarers are known only by titles: the Wilder, Guardian, Iron Eye, Duchess, Raider, Revenant, Recluse, and Executor.
The Guardian belonged to the Scapular Regiment, which used shields to block arrows while the Talon Regiment launched offensive assaults.
The Nox, a race from Elden Ring, were defeated by the Golden Order and forced to live under a false night sky after invoking the Eye of the Greater Will.
